units.source_text: 我在那家茶屋见到先生的时候，他刚脱去衣服准备下海。

en.t: When I saw Sensei at that teahouse, he had just taken off his clothes and was about to go into the sea.

units.source_text: 我当时正从水中走上来，风吹着湿淋淋的身子。

en.t: At that moment I was just coming up out of the water, letting the wind blow over my dripping wet body.

units.source_text: 我们之间隔着不少攒动的人头，若是没有碰到什么特殊情况，我可能会错过先生的。

en.t: Between us were many moving heads, and if not for some special circumstance, I might have missed Sensei entirely.

units.source_text: 但是，尽管海边那么多人，我又是那么懈怠，还是立刻发现了先生，

en.t: But despite the crowd on the beach, and despite my own absentmindedness, I noticed Sensei at once,

units.source_text: 只因为他是和一个外国人结伴来的。

en.t: simply because he had come together with a foreigner.

units.source_text: 一进小茶屋，那个肤色异常白皙的西洋人，便立刻引起了我的注意。

en.t: As soon as he entered the little teahouse, that Westerner with unusually fair skin immediately caught my attention.

units.source_text: 他把身上穿着的日式浴衣脱下来，往长凳上一扔，

en.t: He took off the Japanese yukata he was wearing and tossed it onto a bench,

units.source_text: 抱着手臂，面朝大海站在那里。

en.t: then stood there with his arms folded, facing the sea.

units.source_text: 他身上除了我们平时穿的内裤外，什么衣服也没穿。

en.t: Apart from the sort of underpants we usually wore, he had nothing on at all.

units.source_text: 这首先便让我觉得不可思议。

en.t: That, first of all, struck me as strange.

units.source_text: 两天前，我还去了由井之滨，在沙滩上长时间地观瞧外国人泡海水浴的情景。

en.t: Two days earlier, I had gone to Yuigahama and spent a long time on the beach watching foreigners bathe in the sea.

units.source_text: 我坐在一个小沙丘上，旁边就是某旅馆的后门，在这段时间里，

en.t: I was sitting on a small dune, right beside the back entrance of some hotel, and during that time,

units.source_text: 我看到许多男人海水浴后，从海里走上岸来，

en.t: I saw many men come ashore from the sea after bathing,

units.source_text: 并没有一个人露出身躯、胳膊和大腿，女人们更是将肉体遮掩起来。

en.t: but not one exposed his torso, arms, or thighs, and the women covered their bodies even more carefully.

units.source_text: 人们头上几乎都包着橡胶头巾，

en.t: Almost everyone had a rubber cap wrapped around the head,

units.source_text: 海面上浮动着一片深红色、藏蓝色或蓝色。

en.t: and dark red, navy, and blue colors floated across the surface of the sea.

units.source_text: 对于刚刚目睹了这一景象的我来说，这位只穿着一条游泳裤，

en.t: To me, having just witnessed that scene, this man wearing only a pair of swimming trunks

units.source_text: 堂而皇之地站在大家面前的洋人着实稀罕。

en.t: and standing openly in front of everyone seemed truly unusual.
